name: Dehradun
desc: Families and professionals in Dehradun, Uttarakhand trust Insurance Support for transparent, independent insurance advisory. From policy selection to complex claim recoveries, our IRDAI-certified experts provide dedicated doorstep service.
it_focus: Health and term insurance for engineers and employees at Doiwala IT units and IT Park Selaqui, with wellness-linked premium discounts.
senior_focus: Health insurance and pension advisory designed for retired army officers and senior residents of Garhi Cantt and Rajpur Road.
branch_dets: Direct coordination with LIC branch at Rajpur Road and major insurer offices in Astley Hall.

local_faqs.question: Which hospitals in Dehradun are part of the cashless network?
local_faqs.answer: Max Hospital, Kailash Hospital, Synergy Institute of Medical Sciences, and Shri Mahant Indresh Hospital are in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Can you assist retired army personnel in Garhi Cantt?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we transition ex-servicemen from CGHS/ECHS to individual health plans with proper pre-existing disease coverage and continuous renewal guarantees.
